item.tib: byang chub sgrub thabs legs bshad lam gyi rim pas gzhung
item.coloph: byang chub sgrub thabs legs bshad lam gyi rim pa zhes bya ba tshig bar bdun la shad bar du bgyis pa'i sho lo ka drug cu rtsa brgyad yod pa 'di dag rgyal ba gnyis pa mnyam med chen po'i gdan sa gshen bstan bkra shis sman ri'i dgon du mkhan nyid nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis mtho phyogs spyi bor blangs nas bskul ba'i ngor/ kho bo bsod nams g.yung drung bdag gis bka' lung bre srang gis (gi) 'phrang las gshar nas rtsom pa dge ba dang legs pa'i yon tan thams cad phyogs med kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
